bio: Lian Tai specialises in deep-fried doughnuts. The family uses the original fermented dough recipe concocted by their father more than 5 decades ago. Cooked to a crisp, outer golden-brown with a soft, puffy inside, the Patongo is irresistible when dipped in rich sweet pandan custard....
